updates.title: Main Init
updates.description:
LANHub is a self-hosted LAN gaming and social platform built for local networks. 
Run it on any machine on your network and everyone connects through their browser 
— no accounts, no internet required, no installs.

Games included in this release:

  UNO — Full multiplayer UNO with four game modes:
    · Classic UNO (standard rules)
    · Show 'Em No Mercy (brutal stacking, mercy knockout at 25 cards,
      hand swaps, rotations, and devastating wilds)
    · UNO Attack! (launcher-based drawing — press and hope it doesn't fire)
    · UNO Flip (two-sided deck, Light Side vs the punishing Dark Side)
    · UNO All Wild (every card is a Wild, no matching needed)
  Bots are supported in all modes with Easy / Medium / Hard difficulty.

  GeoGuesser — A Street View guessing game for your LAN.
    · Solo Explorer: guess at your own pace, no timer
    · World Tour: multiplayer rounds with a live leaderboard
    · Draw custom regions on a map, or pick from a preset library
    · Adaptive quadtree coverage search finds real Street View locations
      inside your chosen region every time
    · Preset system: save and share named regions across rooms

  Chess — Full chess with clocks.
    · Play vs a bot (Easy / Medium / Hard) with your choice of time control
    · Challenge any player on the LAN directly, or join a random match queue
    · Full SAN move history, draw offers, resign, and claim draw

  Tetris — Guideline-compliant Tetris.
    · Solo mode, vs Bot, and 1v1 multiplayer with garbage lines
    · SRS rotation, 7-bag randomiser, hold, ghost piece, DAS/ARR tuning
    · Fully rebindable keys and a mobile on-screen control layout
    · Bot uses Dellacherie heuristic with adjustable think speed

  Scribble — A draw-and-guess party game (Skribbl-style).
    · One shared room, automatic game loop with word selection
    · Real-time canvas sync with undo, flood fill, and brush controls
    · Hint system, close-guess detection, and per-round scoring

Other platform features:
  · Theme switcher (dark / light and more)
  · Updates page (this page) — global release notes from the developer
    alongside local announcements from your server's admin team
  · Admin panel for server moderators and DEVs
  · Profanity filtering on all user-facing text inputs
  · Fully LAN-local — nothing leaves your network
